statement: The main experimental confounder is that the context-augmented regime differs from the isolated-triple regime in more than passage provenance: it has more tokens, a different serialization context, and possibly a different triple ordering. Because one retrieved paper attributes gains to merging/ordering and another finds order/size/syntax flat, any measured gain must be shown to exceed a token-matched random-distractor control and an unrelated-entity-neighbourhood control before it can be attributed to passage coherence.
